hash_5dc6f208ff907b86: The Sentinel Artifact... Damn you, Richtofen...
hash_5dc38c08ff8d985d: Speak for yourself - we do this all the damned time.
hash_2fcc2bff689fab74: I did not hope- I could not... Do not be alarmed.
hash_6e7803ab40f9ebaa: -Quickly. He will feel my absence. You must listen.
hash_6e77f6ab40f9d593: Each of you have encountered... been touched by a great power - something has left its mark on your beings...
hash_6e77f5ab40f9d3e0: The warden of this place sensed it - sought you out - tore you from your dimensions, and drained you to take that essence for himself.
hash_6e7479ab40f6cb55: While he has those parts of your souls, he has dominion over you. You cannot fight him any more than you can hope to return to your own worlds.
hash_6e7476ab40f6c63c: To even try would be suicide. But - for all of our sakes, he must be destroyed.
hash_6e7477ab40f6c7ef: There are others here... Ancient denizens of the Dark Aether... Shadowsmiths...
hash_6e7474ab40f6c2d6: They too are bound to his will, augmenting his power. He forced them to harvest your essence, to refine it into the colostrum that sustains him.
hash_6e7475ab40f6c489: These beings cannot be killed... But... Destroy their bonds? Free them from his control?
hash_6e7472ab40f6bf70: Then they will return what they were made to steal.
hash_6e7480ab40f6d73a: Find where the one that watches this place is imprisoned.
hash_6e70f1ab40f3ae66: I cannot act against him directly, but I can guide your hands. Go. Go now.
hash_7059be3b61317a0f: If she says we gotta chuck a necklace into a fuckin\xe2\x80\x99 volcano, I am so out.
hash_1a4bc6e851e72e6f: You will forgive me, if I do not drop everything to do the bidding of a gigantic, floating head.
hash_299fd34e8f0348f5: It is not safe to linger here. He will know his pet is gone. He will investigate.
hash_299fcc4e8f033d10: I have folded the Dark Aether, made a pocket in which you can hide.
hash_37104da7377fc03c: Well, I trust we shall find more of these beasts for the rest of us?
hash_aeccd84547811d0: A weaver of the fabric of this place from the memories it contains. I have always been here. I am a Shadowsmith.
hash_ae9508454750792: You have what was taken. The bonds that imprisoned me are undone. We are both free.
hash_ae9518454750945: Fer\xe2\x80\x98en al ack na feer an shaar. Subtitle: We shall meet again, when fate demands
